mutations.contract: A descending jogged leader takes its lane in reverse walk order, so its vertical run never cuts a later leader's horizontal one.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff descending_leaders_take_a_path_that_cannot_cross (2026-10-30). Lanes back in walk order: the pushed-down demo mechanism crosses in four pairs.
